groups.rule_portions: Three cancellation layers and reminder statistics as pure decisions; excludes first frame, focus, actual key input and scene close. GR-50/B16-A048 empty-state handling uses the approved D53-02b controlled-empty difference, not reproduction of the reference first-draw failure.

groups.tests: tutor success intent and no record, independent forgetting permits HM, approved last-move protection, historical zero moves
groups.rule_portions: HP-45/B16-C126 zero-move teaching and nonempty cancellation model portions only. Zero-move viewing is a controlled pure value under the approved safety policy; the reference detail failure, rendered MOVES page and event result writes are not reproduced or verified. Tutor effects and independent forgetting use WP30 section 6.2/6.3 plus approved r3 section 6.1; last-move protection is the approved D53-04b difference, not a reference-vector expectation.
